item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.36)] Prediction: Broadcom Will Be a $3 Trillion Company by the End of 2030
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.36)
The article predicts that Broadcom will become a $3 trillion company by the end of 2030, representing about 76% upside from its current market value of $1.7 trillion. This prediction is largely based on Broadcom's aggressive revenue targets, particularly in AI semiconductors, which management expects to reach $230 billion in fiscal year 2028. The author argues that achieving this valuation does not require multiple expansion, but rather the company delivering on its secured supply and revenue forecasts, though profitability margins are noted as a key risk.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.05), NVDA Neutral (+0.11)] Apple May Return to Servers With Its Own AI Chips. Nvidia Could Still Get Paid
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.05), NVDA Neutral (+0.11)
Apple is reportedly developing enterprise servers powered by its M8 Ultra chips, potentially targeting a 2029 launch for AI inference. Surprisingly, Apple is considering using NVIDIA's NVLink Fusion technology to connect these processors, suggesting Nvidia could still profit from its networking solutions even if Apple uses its own AI silicon. This move highlights Nvidia's strategy to monetize an increasingly diverse AI hardware market, while Apple aims to re-enter the server business with energy-efficient solutions.

The broader market remains selective, emphasizing business quality and sector-specific demand, which means company-specific execution will be crucial for energy stocks like Exxon Mobil. item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] Intel let RealSense go. Now Cognex is paying $600 million to buy it
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.14)
Cognex is acquiring RealSense, a robotics and computer vision company spun out of Intel, for approximately $600 million. RealSense, which develops depth cameras and computer vision technologies for robots, has grown rapidly since its independence from Intel 14 months ago. This acquisition significantly boosts Cognex's presence in the robotic perception market and provides a substantial return for RealSense employees and investors, including Intel which still holds a 20% stake.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12)] B. Riley Reiterates Buy Ratings on IONQ, QBTS, RGTI Ahead of Quantum World
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.12)
B. Riley Securities has reiterated Buy ratings on IonQ (IONQ), D-Wave Quantum (QBTS), and Rigetti Computing (RGTI) in anticipation of the Quantum World Congress 2026. The firm maintains price targets of $100 for IONQ, $40 for QBTS, and $35 for RGTI, citing a potential shift in U.S. quantum policy from research funding towards commercialization. The upcoming conference, featuring a Department of Energy session "From Lab to Market" and broad government participation, is expected to provide catalysts for the quantum computing sector, potentially leading to new government programs or commercial partnerships for these companies.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.10)] UBS at Bank of America financials conference: growth meets capital pressure
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.10)
UBS CEO Sergio Ermotti discussed the bank's progress at the Bank of America 31st Annual Financials CEO Conference, highlighting strong momentum in wealth management and investment banking. He addressed the Credit Suisse integration, which is nearing completion, and expressed concerns about proposed Swiss capital rules that could significantly impact shareholders. Ermotti emphasized the bank's commitment to growth, shareholder returns through dividends and buybacks, and strategic investments in AI and technology, despite potential regulatory headwinds and market challenges.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.80)] Bull of the Day: NVIDIA Corp. (NVDA)
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.80)
NVIDIA Corp. (NVDA) has regained its Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) status, driven by strong fiscal second-quarter 2027 results where it beat earnings estimates and saw revenue soar 106%. Analysts remain bullish, with estimates for fiscal 2027 and 2028 showing significant earnings and sales growth. Despite a "break" in its stock performance in 2026, NVDA is still up 20.4% year-to-date and is considered attractively priced with a forward P/E of 24.

item.description:

Piper Sandler has revised its price target for Cisco Systems (CSCO) down to $125 from $132, while maintaining a Neutral rating on the stock. This adjustment reflects the analyst firm's updated outlook on the networking equipment giant. The article also provides recent news headlines related to Cisco and its market performance.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.15)] From Prebuilt Agents to Vibe Coding: Salesforce’s New CX Playbook
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.15)
Salesforce's Dreamforce 2026 emphasized making CRM data and workflows accessible everywhere, moving beyond traditional interfaces to integrate AI agents into various work environments. The company aims to provide both turnkey agents for quick deployment and deep customization options for critical customer journeys, with a focus on trust and governance across all interfaces. CX leaders are advised to prioritize customer outcomes, identify clear-cut journeys, and strategically choose deployment models, recognizing that while agents improve, human accountability remains crucial.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.30)] SmartHarvest Portfolios LLC Increases Holdings in NVIDIA Corporation $NVDA
item.description:

SmartHarvest Portfolios LLC significantly increased its stake in NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) by 12.7% in the second quarter, making it their largest holding with a value of $20.5 million. This comes as NVIDIA reported robust earnings, with revenue up 105.9% year-over-year and EPS exceeding analyst expectations. Despite strong analyst sentiment and growth prospects, risks include valuation concerns and significant insider selling, with executives and directors selling $392.7 million in stock over the past 90 days.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] Kraft Heinz Trades at a Fraction of PepsiCo's Valuation. Is the Discount Deserved?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.34)
This article analyzes whether Kraft Heinz's significantly lower valuation compared to PepsiCo and the S&P 500 is justified. It highlights Kraft Heinz's ongoing struggles with declining sales despite management's turnaround efforts, suggesting it might be a value trap. Conversely, PepsiCo's recent turnaround initiatives and positive sales growth make it a more appealing prospect for value investors.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Bullish (+0.25)] Alibaba Just Supercharged its AI Ambitions: New Zhenwu V900 AI Chip Promises 3X Performance, Targets 20GW
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Bullish (+0.25)
Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. has unveiled its new Zhenwu V900 AI chip, promising three times the performance of its predecessor, and plans to expand Alibaba Cloud's global data center capacity to over 20 gigawatts by 2032. The new chip is set for mass production and commercial release in Q1 2027, with existing Zhenwu chips already serving over 650 customers. This move aligns with a broader trend among tech giants like Nvidia and Meta Platforms to significantly boost AI infrastructure.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.25)] Is Generac Holdings Inc. (GNRC) Stock a Top AI Infrastructure Play After $2.4 Billion Amazon Deal?
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.25)
Generac Holdings Inc. (GNRC) is transitioning to become a major power infrastructure supplier for the data center industry, bolstered by a new long-term supply agreement with Amazon worth an estimated $2.4 billion for backup generators in 2027 and 2028. This deal expands Generac's exposure to hyperscale customers and AI-related infrastructure spending, contributing to an already substantial data center backlog. While the agreement offers significant growth potential and revenue visibility, Generac faces risks related to production capacity expansion, delivery schedules, and customer concentration with Amazon.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.25)] Digital Realty Survey Finds More Than Half of Asia Pacific Enterprises Plan to Increase AI Investment by More Than 25%
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.25)
A new survey by Digital Realty indicates that nearly 60% of Asia Pacific (APAC) enterprises plan to increase their AI investment by over 25% in 2026. The 2026 Global Data Insights Survey reveals that while AI investment is strong, individual markets within APAC are pursuing different strategies to derive business value, with Australia showing high ROI, Japan focusing on compliance, Singapore concerned with infrastructure readiness, and South Korea prioritizing interconnection. The report highlights that infrastructure decisions are increasingly tied to AI deployment strategies, emphasizing the need for flexible and interconnected data center solutions across the region.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.13)] Gartner predicts 55% of enterprise VMware users will be investigating an exit by 2029
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.13)
Gartner forecasts that by 2029, 55% of enterprises will begin exploring alternatives to their VMware-based deployments for distributed hybrid infrastructure. This prediction comes six years after Broadcom's acquisition of VMware, which led to negative customer sentiment regarding communication, business practices, and increased costs due to per-core subscriptions. Despite these issues, Gartner still rates VMware as a leader in both Distributed Hybrid Infrastructure and Server Virtualization, alongside competitors like AWS, Nutanix, Microsoft, and Oracle.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.15)] Gartner predicts 55 percent of enterprise VMware users will be investigating an exit by 2029
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.15)
Gartner predicts that by 2029, 55 percent of enterprises will initiate proofs of concept for alternative distributed hybrid infrastructure products to replace their VMware-based deployments. This anticipated shift is largely due to increased negative sentiment from VMware customers regarding communication, commercial practices, and support delays following Broadcom's acquisition. While VMware remains a leader in its market quadrants, rivals like Nutanix, AWS, Microsoft, HPE, and Proxmox are vying for market share, though they also face their own challenges with licensing complexity and feature sets.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] Why Rackspace Technology (RXT) Is Up 15.8% After Joining NVIDIA’s Cloud Partner Program
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.33)
Rackspace Technology (RXT) experienced a 15.8% stock increase after joining NVIDIA’s Cloud Partner Program, which enhances its ability to offer NVIDIA-accelerated computing and governed AI cloud services. This partnership, especially the introduction of Rackspace's Institutional Sovereign Pod combining NVIDIA Blackwell and Palantir Foundry, is crucial for its pivot towards regulated enterprise AI. While this move could drive growth in complex AI workloads, investors are cautioned about potential sustained pressure on margins and free cash flow if AI offerings don't scale rapidly enough to offset challenges in legacy cloud services.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.38), NVDA Bullish (+0.38)] Goldman Leads Sale of $1.1 Billion Junk Bond for CoreWeave-Leased Data Center
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.38), NVDA Bullish (+0.38)
A Goldman Sachs-led group is marketing $1.1 billion in high-yield debt to finance a new data center near Richmond, Virginia. The Digital Drive campus will provide 76 megawatts of IT capacity, fully contracted by CoreWeave for 15 years in a $2.94 billion deal. The bonds are expected to yield in the low to mid 9 percent range, with pricing anticipated for Wednesday.

item.title: [AMZN Bearish (-0.35)] Amazon blocks Meta’s Muse agent from shopping on users’ behalf
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bearish (-0.35)
Amazon has blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from accessing its e-commerce marketplace, citing concerns that Muse doesn't identify itself as an agent when making purchases and can access customer data. This move comes after Muse gained significant popularity, becoming the most downloaded free app on the App Store. Meta is working on enhancing Muse's data protection features, including the upcoming Muse Confidential VM, to address such concerns.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.19)] Claims now being accepted for Apple's iPhone AI settlement. Here's who is eligible
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.19)
Claims are now open for Apple's $250 million settlement regarding alleged unfulfilled Siri and Apple Intelligence features on certain iPhone models. U.S. residents who purchased an eligible iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, or any iPhone 16 model between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025, can file a claim by December 21. Eligible claimants can receive $25 per device, with potential increases up to $95, following a final approval hearing on February 24, 2027.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.11)] Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen Sells $31.3 Million Stock
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.11)
Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen sold approximately 125,000 shares of Adobe Inc. stock for a total of $31.3 million on September 16-17, 2026, representing 34% of his total position. The sale was executed through The Narayen Family Trust and cited as being for personal tax and estate planning purposes. Despite the significant sale and a 30% decline in the stock's value over the past year, the company's growth in fiscal 2026 and current valuation suggest the sale was not driven by concerns about Adobe's business prospects.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.34)] Apple Should Acquire Disney, Robinhood, Uber or these Companies, All-In Podcast Host Says
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.34)
Jason Calacanis, co-host of the All-In Podcast, suggests that Apple should use its "war chest" to make significant acquisitions, despite the company's historical preference for internal growth. He named 10 companies, including public entities like Robinhood, Disney, DoorDash, and Uber, as well as private AI firms, highlighting potential strategic moves for Apple's new CEO, John Ternus. Calacanis believes such acquisitions could help Apple expand into new sectors like AI, finance, logistics, and media, building upon its successful Services segment.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.31)] Fort Worth Makes Rare Earths Great Again at MP Materials' Alliance Facility
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.31)
MP Materials is establishing a critical rare-earth magnet supply chain in Fort Worth, Texas, at its Independence facility, turning domestically mined rare earths into high-performance permanent magnets. This initiative, supported by General Motors and the city of Fort Worth, aims to reduce U.S. dependence on foreign supply chains for strategic minerals, with a larger mega-complex planned in Northlake. The company expects to produce over a million magnets daily at Independence, significantly bolstering American national security and advanced manufacturing.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.22)] Coherent launches optical platform for AI datacenters
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.22)
Coherent Corp. (NYSE:COHR) has launched PhotonLink, an integrated optical platform designed for AI datacenters. This new platform combines various photonics technologies to support co-packaged optics, near-packaged optics, and chip-to-chip connectivity. Coherent expects revenue from PhotonLink to start ramping up in the fourth quarter of calendar year 2026.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.32)] Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) Is Framed By Cloud Demand & Enterprise Artificial
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.32)
Microsoft's performance is currently driven by strong cloud demand and increasing enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence. The article discusses how factors like elevated borrowing costs, cross-border trade rules, market share shifts, and innovation focus influence Microsoft's outlook. Future disclosures on demand trends, operating focus, and cost discipline will provide further clarity on whether current trends become permanent features for the company.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.14)] Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) Cuts Fitness+ Audio Staff As Company Eyes Major Service Overhaul
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (-0.14)
Apple Inc. has laid off employees from its Fitness+ audio division, specifically targeting staff involved in "Time to Walk" and "Time to Run" sessions, as it reconsiders the subscription service's future. The company plans to reduce the frequency of new audio releases and is looking at integrating Fitness+ more deeply into a redesigned Health app. This move comes amidst competitive pressure and coincides with the launch of the new iPhone Duo, with Apple's stock seeing varied short-term sentiment but remaining up 23.3% year to date.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (-0.11)] In rare step, NC Utilities Commission denies Duke Energy permission to build new gas plant
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (-0.11)
The N.C. Utilities Commission has denied Duke Energy's request to build a new gas plant at its Smith Complex, a rare decision driven by concerns over the plant's necessity for data centers and how the costs would be borne by customers. Commissioners stated Duke failed to adequately demonstrate the need for the $584 million turbine or how it would comply with the Ratepayer Protection Pledge. This denial, supported by a majority of commissioners, highlights skepticism about passing costs onto ratepayers and suggests Duke needs to provide a more thorough analysis of alternatives and cost-sharing, particularly with regard to data center power consumption.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.12)] Meta’s Muse is outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.12)
Meta's new AI app, Muse, is showing stronger initial mobile performance than ChatGPT did in its early days, according to Apptopia data. Muse has garnered more downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada during its first twelve days, even when comparing only iOS data. This early success suggests Muse could become another major hit for Meta, potentially leveraging the company's powerful cross-promotion strategies seen with apps like Threads.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] AMD joins the $1 trillion club, leaving Intel behind
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.34)
AMD has achieved a $1 trillion market capitalization for the first time, driven by investor enthusiasm for its growing AI and data-center business. This milestone places AMD ahead of longtime rival Intel, whose market value is around $644 billion, though it remains significantly smaller than Nvidia. The company's recent stock rally, with shares up over 180% this year, reflects strong demand for AI hardware and AMD's robust growth in its Data Center segment.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (-0.15)] In rare step, NC Utilities Commission denies Duke Energy permission to build new gas plant
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (-0.15)
The North Carolina Utilities Commission has denied Duke Energy's request to build a sixth combustion turbine at its Smith Complex, citing concerns about timing, cost, and the proportion of power intended for data centers. This decision is a rare move for the commission, which typically approves Duke Energy's requests. Commissioners highlighted Duke's failure to adequately address how data centers would contribute to the costs and to compare the proposed facility against other energy resources as required by new state laws.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.34), AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] Litmus Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner(R) Magic Quadrant(TM) for Global Industrial AIoT Platforms
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.34), AMZN Bullish (+0.31)
Litmus, a provider of Industrial Data Platform for AI, has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Industrial AIoT Platforms. The company's platform helps manufacturers standardize data pipelines across plants, making data ready for enterprise AI initiatives. Litmus also emphasizes its strategic partnerships with major technology vendors like Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS, Databricks, and Snowflake, to bring governed factory data into analytics and AI services.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Is Up 12.1% After Record AI Backlog Sparks Major Capacity Expansion
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.31)
Super Micro Computer (SMCI) has seen its stock rise by 12.1% following a record AI-focused order backlog, including over US$60 billion in new fourth-quarter orders. The company is expanding its global manufacturing capacity to produce more than 6,000 racks per month to meet growing data center demand, with AI solutions now contributing the majority of its quarterly revenue. This growth sharpens the company's investment narrative but also highlights risks related to customer concentration and potential order lumpiness.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.21)] Why Turning Point Brands Stock Dived by 10% Today
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.21)
Turning Point Brands' stock dropped 10% following two key announcements: an unexpected change in leadership with CEO Graham Purdy stepping down due to personal reasons, and a reduction in the high end of its full-year EBITDA forecast from $90 million to $70 million. These developments, coupled with existing challenges in the tobacco industry, have increased investor concern, despite the company maintaining its sales estimates for oral tobacco products. The article suggests that while not necessarily a cause for panic, the stock is not considered a buy given the industry's difficulties.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.13)] CCIA Joins Supreme Court Amicus Brief in Apple v. Epic
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.13)
The Computer & Communications Industry Association (CCIA) has filed an amicus brief supporting Apple Inc. in the Supreme Court case Apple v. Epic. The brief argues against a lower court's ruling that found Apple in contempt for violating the "spirit" of an order, even without explicit prohibition, stating that such a standard creates uncertainty and contradicts federal law. CCIA President & CEO Matt Schruers emphasized the importance of clear, text-based court orders, especially concerning protected speech and editorial curation.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.25)] eBay Upgraded, Airbnb Downgraded: Updated Rankings on Top Blue-Chip Stocks
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.25)
Louis Navellier has updated his Stock Grader recommendations for 95 blue-chip stocks based on institutional buying pressure and fundamental health. The article details a comprehensive list of upgrades and downgrades across various sectors, with notable changes including eBay being upgraded to "Strong" and Airbnb downgraded to "Neutral." Navellier encourages subscribers to use Stock Grader for personalized stock ratings.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.10)] Costco will open 10 new US stores in the next two months. Here are the locations
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.10)
Costco is set to open 10 new stores across nine US states in October and November as part of its ongoing expansion efforts to add over 30 new stores annually. These new locations, including California, New York, Texas, and more, aim to capitalize on the growing demand for bulk retailers amid rising grocery prices. The company reported significant net sales growth in its 2026 fiscal year and continues to see strong customer traffic despite economic pressures.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.34)] This is the ‘most underappreciated’ driver for Microsoft’s business, according to one analyst
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.34)
Jefferies analyst Brent Thill believes that Microsoft's software business, particularly Microsoft 365 Cloud with its AI add-ons, is the most underappreciated driver for the company's future growth. While investors focus on cloud computing, Thill highlights the significant revenue potential in enhancing traditional enterprise software like Word and Excel through artificial intelligence. This perspective suggests a key opportunity often overlooked in Microsoft's overall AI narrative.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] Jefferies Financial stock may move 5.8% on Sept. 28 earnings
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.33)
Jefferies Financial Group Inc. stock is predicted to move 5.8% based on options data when the company reports earnings on September 28. Historically, the actual stock price movement has exceeded this implied volatility in three out of the last eight earnings announcements. For instance, in June, options suggested a 6.4% move, but the stock fell 15.1% after the earnings release.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] Broadcom’s AI Opportunity Is Bigger Than Its Stock Price Suggests
item.description:
